name: Being Ugly
overview: Scripture reveals that God's creation, including every person, is inherently good and wonderfully made, as affirmed in Genesis 1:31 and Psalms 139:14. While outward beauty is often fleeting and deceptive, Proverbs 31:30 emphasizes that true worth lies in a reverent fear of the Lord rather than physical appearance. Isaiah 53:2 highlights that even the Messiah had no form or comeliness that would attract human desire, illustrating that God's purposes transcend external looks. Job 31:15 reminds us that our very formation is the work of the same Creator, affirming the divine intentionality behind every individual.
